coexistence.description: **Ecological closure — coexistence.** Continuous coexistence of ≥2 trophic roles (each holding ≥5% of living cells) for ≥ 10⁵ steps, computed from the scheduled role observations in `series.jsonl`. `rolesPresent` is recorded only on deep censuses (every `deepEvery` censuses); the duration is measured across consecutive *deep* censuses only — a non-deep census carries no role information and neither continues nor breaks a coexistence run. Hypothesis: a majority of treatment runs reach a qualifying duration (≥3 roles sustained the same way is the M5 gate, reported alongside; it is not required for this endpoint).
